question: Which statement is false?
explanation:
Every identity matrix is a scalar matrix.

Every scalar matrix is a diagonal matrix.

Not every diagonal matrix is a scalar matrix.

Every square matrix can be written as a sum of a symmetric and a skew symmetric matrix.

Thus, statement (C) is false.

options.A: Every identity matrix is a scalar matrix.
options.B: Every scalar matrix is a diagonal matrix.
options.C: Every diagonal matrix is a scalar matrix.
options.D: Every square matrix can be written as a sum of a symmetric and a skew symmetric matrix.
